dict.string: Perch shows your upcoming calendar events beside your tasks and focus timer. Your events stay on this Mac and are never changed.
Perch keeps a “Perch” list in Reminders in step with your tasks, so they reach your iPhone and Watch. It only changes that list.
Perch listens only while you speak a task. Speech is recognized on this Mac and never recorded or sent anywhere.
Perch turns what you say into tasks using on-device speech recognition. Nothing you say leaves this Mac.
Perch watches for new screenshots and screen recordings so they hang on Clips the moment you take them. It never changes your files.
Perch watches the folder your screenshots are saved to so they hang on Clips. It never changes your files.
